setup: A fraction between 0 and 1 is found by dividing the line from 0 to 1 into [[den]] equal gaps and counting [[num]] of them.

steps.say: $\frac{[[num]]}{[[den]]}$ means [[num]] of the [[den]] equal gaps, so on a 0-to-1 line it sits at [[dec]].
Every part is the same size, which is what makes the position a fraction of the whole rather than an approximation.

answer: So the point is [[dec]] along a number line running from 0 to 1.
